rawContent: In just a few weeks, countries will decide on the Paris Climate Agreement's rulebook at #COP24. The #PeoplesDemands call for what we all need: real, just climate solutions to #climatechange. Add your name to the demands at https://t.co/oeg2HYrohB

@NancyPelosi The reality of #climatechange requires action at a scale we’ve rarely seen before in history. Support the #GreenNewDeal and the creation of a Select Committee to turn the proposal into a policy plan.
